name: SQL setup restarts preserve the scenario clock
title: SC-13-02-12 SQL setup restarts preserve the scenario clock
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the site is in state F5 with the clock at "2026-11-19"
When the backend restarts to reload SQL setup
Then liabilities retain their "2026-11-19" penalty calculations
